description.value: Embers Brewhouse is a craft brewpub that opened in 2025 in downtown Kamloops, serving house-made beers alongside a food menu in a casual sit-down setting. Situated on Victoria Street in the city core, it sits on a natural route through town for cyclists riding the TransCanada or exploring the Kamloops area. Regular programming like Saturday trivia nights points to an active local gathering spot rather than a purely tourist-facing operation.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is active, located at 650 Victoria Street Kamloops, and the phone number (250) 372-0769 matches the OSM value. The 'Order Online' navigation link provides positive evidence for takeout, but the menu page rendered no item content, leaving dietary and most amenity fields null. Two discrepancies need flagging: subpages consistently use the name 'Embers Brewpub' rather than 'Embers Brewhouse', and the contact email on the website (emberskamloops@gmail.com) differs from the OSM email (embersfeedback@gmail.com).
concerns: Name inconsistency: OSM and the front page use 'Embers Brewhouse', but all website subpages are titled 'Embers Brewpub' — the business may trade under both names or the OSM entry may need updating.
Email discrepancy: OSM records 'embersfeedback@gmail.com' but the website contact page lists 'emberskamloops@gmail.com'.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Confirmed-open craft brewpub in downtown Kamloops with food and house-made beer; a practical food-and-drink stop for touring cyclists despite limited amenity detail available on the website.
